description: Display information about known users in the system.

option.name: --acc-expiration
tip: Display info about password expiration.

option.name: --btmp-file
tip: Set an alternate path for btmp.

option.name: --colon-separate
tip: Display data in a format similar to /etc/passwd.

option.name: --context
tip: Display SELinux contexts.

option.name: --export
tip: Display in an export-able output format.

option.name: --failed
tip: Display data about the users' last failed logins.

option.name: --groups
tip: Display users belonging to a group in <groups>.

option.name: --help
tip: Display this help.

option.name: --last
tip: Show info about the users' last login sessions.

option.name: --lastlog
tip: Set an alternate path for lastlog.

option.name: --lastlog2
tip: Set an alternate path for lastlog2.

option.name: --logins
tip: Display only users from <logins>.

option.name: --newline
tip: Display each piece of information on a new line.

option.name: --noheadings
tip: Don't print headings.

option.name: --notruncate
tip: Don't truncate output.

option.name: --output
tip: Define the columns to output.

option.name: --output-all
tip: Output all columns.

option.name: --print0
tip: Delimit user entries with a nul character.

option.name: --pwd
tip: Display information related to login by password.

option.name: --raw
tip: Display in raw mode.

option.name: --shell
tip: Use column names to be usable as shell variable identifiers.

option.name: --supp-groups
tip: Display information about groups.

option.name: --system-accs
tip: Display system accounts.

option.name: --time-format
tip: Display dates in short, full or iso format.
Possible values: short, full, iso

option.name: --user-accs
tip: Display user accounts.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version.

option.name: --wtmp-file
tip: Set an alternate path for wtmp.
